### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A33, A34, A36, A37, A38, A39, A40, A41 appear in about 99–100% of traces (mean occurrences ~1.0) compared to about 54% (mean ~0.54) before. [OCC002–OCC009]
- A06 appears in about 14% of traces (mean 0.14) vs 29% before, and now almost never appears without those activities: A06-only dropped from about 13–16% to 0%, while those activities appear alone in about 86% of traces. [OCC001, REL001–REL008]
- A14, A15, A30, A31 now co-occur with A33–A41 in about 99% of traces, up from about 54%. [REL009–REL032, REL033–REL040]
- The positions of A33, A34, A36, A37 shifted earlier (mean from ~0.74 to ~0.65), while A40 and A41 shifted later (from ~0.74 to ~0.77). [POS006–POS011]
- Many pairs involving A30, A33, A34, A36, A37 with A31 or A38–A41 now have lag 5 (about 96–98%) instead of spread lags. [LAG004–LAG011]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a hypothesis that a set of activities A33–A41 became part of the standard flow, appearing in nearly all traces, while A06 became rare and only appears together with that set. This is supported by the large increase in participation of A33–A41, the near-universal co-occurrence of A14, A15, A30, A31 with them, and the consistent changes in successor distributions and positions. [OCC002–OCC009, REL009–REL032, DIR001–DIR007, POS006–POS011] A competing explanation that the differences are due to sampling variation in variant frequencies is unlikely given the number and consistency of the items, but cannot be entirely ruled out. [OCC001, REL001–REL008]
